name: The Big March of Animals
source_text: Until the End Phase, increase the ATK of all face-up Beast-Type monsters on your side of the field by 200 points for each Beast-Type monster on your side of the field.
notes: Each face-up Beast on your side receives the same per-Beast bonus.
